label: global_class_field_theory
title: global_class_field_theory
statement: \notready If $N$ is a finite extension of $\Q$ then there are two ``canonical'' isomorphisms of topological groups between the profinite abelian groups $\pi_0(\A_N^\times/N^\times)$ and $\GN^{\ab}$; one sends local uniformisers to arithmetic Frobenii and the other to geometric Frobenii; each of the global isomorphisms is compatible with the local isomorphisms above.
proof: \notready This is the main theorem of global class field theory; see for example Tate's article in~\cite{cf}.
